scripts.check:bitcanvas: node --check BitCanvas/pixelart.js && node --check BitCanvas/gamesync.js && node --check BitCanvas/app.js
scripts.launcher:build: set "PATH=%PATH%;%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer" && dotnet publish launcher/src -c Release
scripts.check:launcher: dotnet build launcher/src -c Release && dotnet test launcher/tests
scripts.check:server: cd server && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run pyright && uv run pytest
scripts.check:web: cd web && npm run gen:types && npm run build
